name: PT Harapan Duta Pertiwi Tbk
summary: PT Harapan Duta Pertiwi Tbk engages in automotive body manufacturing. It operates through the following segments: Hauling and Overburden for Mining Projects, Cut and Fill Soil Dredging for Construction Projects, Fuel Transportation, Food Logistics Transportation, and Commercial Materials Logistics Transportation and Others. The company was founded on January 26, 2005 and is headquartered in Tangerang, Indonesia.
